summary: Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Trust 2025-5C3 filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a special servicer appointment for a single loan, The Outlet Collection Seattle Mortgage Loan (~2.1% of pool). Greystone Servicing Company LLC was removed and CWCapital Asset Management LLC appointed as successor special servicer under the BMO 2024-5C8 PSA, effective July 29, 2026. This routine servicing administrative update is not a special situation; no transaction, stake, price, or recommendation involved. What to watch: servicing continuity on the loan; no risk-arb angle.
